description: Two-span multi-day setting plus an out-of-range holiday, with a transcription error in the source.
content: Full loom all next week and the following week until Thursday, Holiday on 7/3
notes: This is the designated known-hard fixture. Three separate difficulties stack: (1) 'all next week' must expand to Mon-Fri 06-15..06-19 using the supplied workday anchors; (2) 'the following week until Thursday' must expand to 06-22..06-25, a week the prompt supplies no anchors for; (3) 'Holiday on 7/3' falls outside both spans entirely. must_include is empty on the setting nodes because the source contains a speech-to-text error ('Full loom' for 'FullBloom', corrected by the user in the very next capture), so asserting the label text would grade transcription rather than date expansion.
